tagline: WZFO取景器相机，1969 年发布
description: WZFO于1969年推出的取景器相机。配备fixed, meniscus, 75 mm 1:8。快门速度guillotine everset shutter, 1/50 s and B shutter speeds。使用manual, with red window。fix focus, from 2 m to infinity。

specs.对焦: fix focus, from 2 m to infinity
specs.快门: guillotine everset shutter, 1/50 s and B shutter speeds
specs.英文简介: The Ami 66 is a toy viewfinder cameras made of plastic and issued from 1969 to c.1985 by the Polish firm Warszawskie Zakłady Fotooptyczne (WZFO).
